lead.en: Derive discrete masses and cumulative distributions, distinguish density from probability, construct quantile samplers, and preserve all preimages or inverse-coordinate factors when transforming variables.
lead.zh: 推离散质量与累积分布，区分密度及概率，构造分位抽样，变换时保全部原像或逆坐标因子。

prerequisites.en: Module 21 for every route. Module 17 for the labelled continuous AI branch; CS learners use discrete bridges and equal-time assessment alternatives. Labs use only the Python standard library.
prerequisites.zh: 所有路线需模块 21。标记连续AI分支需模块 17；CS用离散衔接及等时练习替代。实验仅需Python标准库。

en: Distinguish outcome maps, realisations and distributions through event preimages.
Derive Bernoulli, categorical, binomial and geometric models and state Poisson assumptions.
Use CDF jumps and endpoint identities; AI learners additionally normalise densities and retain mixed atoms.
Construct generalised quantiles and inverse samplers with explicit endpoint conventions.
Sum discrete transformation preimages; AI learners derive absolute inverse factors and multiple branches.
Select mechanisms, supports and parameter conventions, and diagnose numerical and modelling faults.
zh: 通过事件原像区分映射、实现与分布。
推Bernoulli、类别、二项、几何，并写Poisson假设。
用CDF跳及端点；AI额外归一密度并保混合原子。
构造广义分位和明确端点的逆抽样。
合离散原像；AI推绝对逆因子及多分支。
选机制、支持、参数约定，诊断数值及模型错误。

text.en: Read Sections 1–2 and derive masses from their experiments.
text.zh: 阅读第 1–2 节，由实验推质量。

text.en: Complete Exercises 1–4 with your branch alternative.

text.zh: 阅读随机变量与支持定义。

text.en: Retrieve PMF, CDF and waiting conventions.
Read Sections 3–4; CS uses the discrete bridge, AI uses Module 17.
text.zh: 阅读第 3–4 节；CS用离散衔接，AI用模块 17。

text.en: Check exact discrete normalisation and omitted infinite tails.
text.zh: 查精确离散归一与遗漏无限尾。

text.en: Complete proof Exercises 5–7 with your branch alternative.
Read Sections 5–6; follow all preimages and applicable continuous factors.
text.zh: 阅读第 5–6 节，保原像及适用连续因子。

text.en: Compare empirical CDFs; CS inspects discrete outputs, AI adds continuous outputs.
text.zh: 比较经验CDF；CS查离散，AI加连续输出。

text.en: Complete application Exercises 8–10 with your branch alternative.
Repair your branch's preimage or Jacobian faults and support mismatches.
text.zh: 按路线修原像或Jacobian错误及支持不符。

text.en: Complete choices and your branch's written transformation.
text.zh: 完成选择及路线书面变换。

text.en: Complete the exit task and audit total probability.
